slides.texte: Three parts of the same life. None of them is optional.

slides.titre: I started HYROX to see how far I could go.
slides.texte: While keeping a very full professional and family life. Since then, the project has become something else.
I'm married and dad to a little boy. My training has to find its place in a family life I care about deeply.
A sales team and key accounts across France, Spain and Italy. An international, demanding environment, built on performance.

slides.titre: Not the image of a **pro athlete.**

slides.titre: All three, all the way to June.

legende:
Father. Executive. Athlete.

Sport is not my full-time job. I'm married, dad to a little boy, and I lead a sales team across France, Spain and Italy. HYROX has to find its place in the middle of all that.

Behind the races and the podiums, there's mostly organisation: early sessions, travel, and a family that is part of the adventure ❤️

I'm not trying to look like a pro athlete. I want to show that you can chase ambitious goals without putting your family, your career or your responsibilities aside.

If that's your life too, tell me how you make it work. I read everything 🙏

#hyrox #hyroxfrance #workingdad #roadtohongkong #hybridathlete
